name: Learning to Ride
summary: Genn Fairweather offers to teach you to ride a galestrider for a fee. Training prepares you to travel with a mount, and he provides one mount after you learn.

sections.title: A Steady Hand
sections.body: After you have enough coin, Genn Fairweather can teach you the Apprentice Riding skill. He says riding a galestrider takes patience and a steady hand. He provides a mount once you have trained, so you can set out prepared for what you and your mount may face.

faq.q: Who teaches me to ride a galestrider?
faq.answer: Genn Fairweather teaches you the Apprentice Riding skill for galestriders.

faq.q: Do I need to pay for riding lessons?
faq.answer: Genn asks for a fee and says to speak with him when you have enough coin.

faq.q: Do I get a mount after training?
faq.answer: Genn provides you with a free mount once you have trained with him.

faq.q: Can I ride other creatures too?
faq.answer: Genn says many creatures require their own riding skill, and you will need to find trainers for each.

faq.q: What does riding a galestrider take?
faq.answer: Genn says riding a galestrider often takes patience and a steady hand.
